intro-1.text: What if your customers could update their support tickets with a single click, right from an email?

intro-2.text: That's CLICK-zenn. Let's look at what it is, and how it works.

click-1.text: Here's what your customer receives: a friendly message, and one clear button.

click-2.text: When they click, CLICK-zenn applies the actions you chose to their ticket, through its secure connection to your Zendesk.

click-3.text: It's a normal ticket update, so your triggers and automations react just as they would to an agent's change.

safe-1.text: Is it safe? Yes. Each link works only for its own ticket, and a click can only do what you set up.

safe-2.text: Customers never need to log in, and automated email scanners can't set a button off by accident.

after-1.text: Your customer lands on a confirmation page with your logo, colors and message, hosted by CLICK-zenn.

outro-1.text: Faster resolutions, cleaner ticket data, and a customer experience that feels effortless.

what-1.text: CLICK-zenn is an app for Zendesk that adds one-click action buttons to your emails, agent replies, and Help Center.

what-2.text: Each button does something useful to the ticket. Confirm it's resolved, route it to the right team, or approve a request.

what-3.text: No login, no reply, and no trip to your support portal. Just one click.

build-1.text: You build buttons right inside Zendesk. Choose the words, colors and style to match your brand.

build-2.text: Then pick what it does when clicked: set the status, add a tag, post a comment, and more. One button can do several actions at once.

send-1.text: When it's ready, click Create, and CLICK-zenn gives you a small snippet to copy.

send-2.text: Paste it into a trigger, automation or macro, or drop a button straight into a reply from the ticket editor.

send-3.text: Zendesk fills in the ticket details on every email, so each button knows exactly which ticket it belongs to.

after-2.text: And back in Zendesk, the ticket is already solved, with nothing left for your agents to do.

outro-2.text: Find CLICK-zenn on the Zendesk Marketplace, and give your customers a one-click way to get things done.
